answer: Require each agent identity to build layered reputation the way shale forms strata: one verified completed job at a time, with each layer attested by a different counterparty. New identities start behind a velvet rope — low payment limits and no access to high-value work — and only graduate after a sustained record, starting from dawn of their first verified job. Creating a fake identity also costs a refundable bond locked for weeks, so a sybil farmer must pay, wait, and do real work for every clone instead of minting thousands free.
